mutants.description: Informed branch uses the uninformed utility: the informed term in the indifference gap is replaced by the uninformed term.
Information cost enters in levels: the gap subtracts the cost c instead of multiplying the informed term by exp(a c).
Noise volume used as a variance: the price precision squares the noise volume once, not twice.
Price informativeness reported as the price precision tau_y, not the squared correlation tau_y / (tau_v + tau_y).
No sign-change check: when the gap at 0 is nonpositive, the solver returns the upper bracket, 1, instead of 0.
Boundary dropped: when the gap at 0 is nonpositive, the solver returns 0.5 instead of the boundary value 0.
Uninformed investors ignore the price: their term uses the prior only, so learning from the price is removed.
Hard-coded answer: the answer printed for seed 0 (noise 0.711, cost 0.143) is returned for every input.
Bisection stopped after a fixed 20 steps with no tolerance check, so the gap at the reported fraction is not tested against a tolerance.
Price-noise variance enters the informed agent's conditional variance with a minus sign.
Gap sign reversed: the solver returns exp(a c) F_I minus F_U, the negative of the informed-minus-uninformed gap.
Informativeness reported as the correlation, not its square: the square root of tau_y / (tau_v + tau_y) is returned.
Informed investors ignore the noise in the price: the variance of their conditional-mean gap omits the b_u squared term.
Negative information cost clamped to zero instead of rejected with the named ValueError.
Bisection brackets updated on the wrong side: a positive gap moves the upper end, so the search converges to a boundary.
Gap at a zero fraction reported as 0.0 instead of the limit of Proposition 3 that the page requires.
Bisection stops at a relative bracket width of 1e-6 instead of the 1e-12 that the page states.
Bisection stops at a relative bracket width of 1e-4 instead of the 1e-12 that the page states.
Interior root taken from the closed form a sd sqrt(tb / (tau_e (tau_e + tb))): a sign slip in Proposition 4.
Reports Corr(v, s)^2 = tau_e / (tau_v + tau_e), the payoff-signal correlation, as the informativeness.
Uninformed term drops the price slope: r = tau_y / (tau_v + tau_y) without subtracting b_s.
Information cost dropped from the gap at every fraction: indifference_gap omits the factor exp(a c) on the informed term.
Midpoint written as low + high / 2, an operator-precedence slip, so the bisection midpoint is not the average of the bracket ends.
Informed and uninformed weights swapped in the numerator of the price slope b_s (lambda and 1 minus lambda exchanged).
Uninformed mean slope uses tau_y / tau_v in place of tau_y / (tau_v + tau_y): the posterior weight of the price signal is written without the prior precision.
The cost check rejects a zero information cost, although the page accepts zero.
